decisions.maskingSource: tree-sitter grammar comment/string nodes (no character scanning, no JS/C-only mask)
decisions.interpolationReexposed: template_substitution, interpolation, interpolation_expression, string_interpolation, expansion, simple_expansion, command_substitution, arithmetic_expansion, process_substitution, subshell, variable_name, interpolated_expression
decisions.referenceIdentity: leaf identifier nodes tagged with nodeType + parentType + exact byte range (never a raw-text substring match)
decisions.freshness: reuses brain/freshness.ts checkFileFreshness/checkSymbolFreshness; assertFresh* throws on any stale/missing

limitations: Dynamic-language reference node types beyond identifier/variable/variable_name/simple_variable/constant (e.g. PHP 'name', Clojure 'sym_lit', SQL object/column reference identification) are mapped in E2/E3 when bb_edit consumes these primitives.

SQL string/numeric literals share the grammar node type 'literal' (both masked as non-reference bytes); PowerShell `$var` occurrences include the `$` sigil in their text; PowerShell expandable-string variable re-exposure is an E3 refinement.
Regex literals are left as code; their pattern text is not an identifier node so extraction is unaffected (brace-body scanning for insert is E4).
C/C++ compiler-extension normalization and the 1MB parse cap are shared with parseFile via ASTEngine.parseTree so byte offsets agree with the index.
